verse.text: For I am not ashamed of the gospel, because it is the power of God that brings salvation to everyone who believes: first to the Jew, then to the Gentile.

reflection.scripture: For I am not ashamed of the gospel, because it is the power of God that brings salvation to everyone who believes: first to the Jew, then to the Gentile.
reflection.observation: Paul writes with bold conviction—he is not ashamed of the gospel. This isn't just personal confidence; it's a declaration that the gospel's power transcends every boundary. The message of salvation through faith in Christ is not limited by ethnicity, background, or status. It is for everyone who believes. Paul, who once persecuted Christians, now stands unashamed because he has experienced the transformative power of this message firsthand.
reflection.application: In a world that often treats faith as private or even embarrassing, Paul's words challenge us to examine our own posture. Do we shrink back from sharing our faith, or do we carry it with the same unashamed confidence? The gospel is still the power of God for salvation today—for our coworkers, neighbors, and friends. Our role is not to convince or convert, but to boldly live and share the hope we have.
reflection.prayer: Lord, thank You for the power of the gospel that saved me and continues to transform me. Give me the same boldness Paul had—to live unashamed of my faith and to share Your love freely with those around me. Help me remember that this good news is for everyone, and use me as a vessel of Your grace today. In Jesus' name, amen.
